integrity: All mathematical claims use the same specified finite iid model. Conditional distribution comparisons are proved analytically; no independent validation or originality certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive iid categorical draws with replacement only; no claim for dependent sampling, group arrivals, or zero probability labels. Exact-rational finite checks supplement but do not replace the proof. Historical-priority coverage in older total-positivity/occupancy literature is not completely excluded.
title: Strict likelihood-ratio ordering of coupon-collection times by the final coupon
